title: Those Excluded from the Assembly

questions.question: Who shall not enter the assembly of the Lord (regarding reproductive organs)?
options: No one whose testicles are crushed or whose male organ is cut off
questions.correctAnswer: No one whose testicles are crushed or whose male organ is cut off
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:1 (ESV): "No one whose testicles are crushed or whose male organ is cut off shall enter the assembly of the Lord."

questions.question: How long are Ammonites and Moabites excluded?
options: Even to the tenth generation, none... forever
questions.correctAnswer: Even to the tenth generation, none... forever
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:3 (ESV): "No Ammonite or Moabite may enter... even to the tenth generation... forever."

questions.question: Why were Ammon and Moab excluded?
options: Because they did not meet Israel with bread and water and hired Balaam
questions.correctAnswer: Because they did not meet Israel with bread and water and hired Balaam
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:4 (ESV): "because they did not meet you with bread and with water... and because they hired against you Balaam..."

questions.question: Did God listen to Balaam?
options: No, He turned the curse into a blessing
questions.correctAnswer: No, He turned the curse into a blessing
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:5 (ESV): "But the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam; instead the Lord your God turned the curse into a blessing..."

questions.question: Who should you not abhor?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:7 (ESV): "You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land."

questions.question: Slaves who escape to you from their masters should not be what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:15 (ESV): "You shall not give up to his master a slave who has escaped from his master to you."

questions.question: What is forbidden regarding lending to a brother?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:19 (ESV): "You shall not charge interest on loans to your brother..."

questions.question: To whom can you charge interest?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:20 (ESV): "You may charge a foreigner interest, but you may not charge your brother interest..."

questions.question: If you make a vow to the Lord, what must you do?
options: You shall not delay to pay it
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not delay to pay it
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:21 (ESV): "If you make a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay fulfilling it..."

questions.question: What cleanliness rule applies to the camp regarding using the bathroom?
options: Go outside the camp and cover the excrement with a tool
questions.correctAnswer: Go outside the camp and cover the excrement with a tool
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:12–13 (ESV): "You shall have a place outside the camp... And you shall have a trowel... and dig a hole... and cover up your excrement."

questions.question: Why must the camp be holy?
options: Because the Lord walks in the midst of the camp
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Lord walks in the midst of the camp
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:14 (ESV): "Because the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp... therefore your camp must be holy..."

questions.question: When entering a neighbor's vineyard, what can you do?
options: Eat grapes until satisfied, but put none in your bag
Take as many as you want
questions.correctAnswer: Eat grapes until satisfied, but put none in your bag
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:24 (ESV): "When you go into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes... but you shall not put any in your bag."

questions.question: When entering a neighbor's standing grain, what can you do?
options: Pluck the ears with your hand, but not use a sickle
questions.correctAnswer: Pluck the ears with your hand, but not use a sickle
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:25 (ESV): "...you may pluck the ears with your hand, but you shall not put a sickle to your neighbor's standing grain."

questions.question: What wages are forbidden to be brought into the house of the Lord?
options: The fee of a prostitute or the wages of a dog (male prostitute)
questions.correctAnswer: The fee of a prostitute or the wages of a dog (male prostitute)
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:18 (ESV): "You shall not bring the fee of a prostitute or the wages of a dog into the house of the Lord..."

questions.question: When can Edomites and Egyptians enter the assembly?
options: The children of the third generation
questions.correctAnswer: The children of the third generation
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 23:8 (ESV): "The children of the third generation that are born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord."

key_verse_text: But the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam; instead the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loved you. (ESV)
